 To :  - THE STATE SECURITIES COMMISSION 
- THE HO CHI MINH STOCK EXCHANGE 
 
Pursuant to the regulations on information disclosure according to Circular No. 96/2020/TT -
BTC dated November 16, 2020 , of the Ministry of Finance, Gia Lai Electricity Joint Stock 
Company (stock symbol: GEG) hereby provides the following explanation for the variance of 
over 10% in its profit after corporate income tax (CIT)  in the Income Statement for Quarter 
3/2025 compared to the same period last year: 
Unit: billion VND 
No Item Quarter 3/2025 Quarter 3/2024 Change Q3/2025-Q3/2024 
1 
Profit after CIT in 
Separate Financial 
Statement 
73.85  1.27  72.58  
2 
Profit after CIT in 
Consolidated Financial 
Statement 
80.06  (47.80)  127.86  
1. Profit after corporate income tax according to the Separate Income Statement for Q3 2025 
reached VND 73.85 billion, an increase of VND 72.58 billion compared to the same period 
due to the following reasons: 
- Revenue from sales of electricity increased by more than VND 8 billion, 
- Financial expenses decreased by more than VND 95 billion, mainly due to lower provisions 
for investments in subsidiaries and associates. 
2. Profit after corporate income tax according to the Consolidated Income Statement for Q3 
2025 reached VND 80.06 billion, an increase of VND 127.86 billion compared to the same 
period due to the following reasons: 
- Revenue from sales of electricity increased by nearly VND 127 billion, as Tan Phu Dong 
1 Wind Power Plant and wind turbine A7 of VPL Wind Power Plant had official electricity 
selling prices.  
Above is the explanation of Gia Lai Electricity Joint Stock Company on the variance in 
profit after CIT on the Income Statement for Q 3 2025 compared to the same period last 
year. 
Respectfully submitted.
